name: hazop-actions
description: Reconcile HAZOP and PHA recommendations with the action tracker and close-out records. Matches node, deviation and recommendation numbers to action IDs from pasted worksheet and tracker rows; lists recommendations with no action, actions with no recommendation, changed wording, stale revisions, missing owners and due dates, overdue and turnaround items; checks closed and declined actions against their MOC, work order and revision records; and works out the five-year revalidation date and carry-over list. For PHA coordinators, process safety engineers and HAZOP scribes.
